summary_en: 9,700,000 shares cancelled under Companies Act Article 178, effective 2026-06-30. Post-cancellation outstanding shares: 40,242,221.
title_en: Notice of Completion of Cancellation of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Kureha Corporation completed the cancellation of 9,700,000 treasury shares on 2026-06-30 pursuant to Article 178 of the Companies Act, following a board resolution dated 2026-05-12. The cancelled shares represented 19.4% of the outstanding share count before cancellation. Post-cancellation outstanding shares total 40,242,221.
